title: 第二百二十章 开办师承班获得二十万现金奖励第二百一十九章 大壮我想你
content_zh:
第二百二十章开办师承班！获得二十万现金奖励！
张忠义的目光落在王大壮和孙菲菲身上，语气比刚才正式了一些：“各位同仁，为期半个月的中西医临床实训已经圆满结束。这期间涌现出了一些表现突出的年轻人，也暴露出了一些问题。”
他翻开面前的文件夹：“在柳树沟的五个村子，参与实训的中医学生一共接诊了超过三百人次，发放中药制剂一百七十余剂，完成针灸治疗八十余人次。”
“特别值得表扬的是王大壮和孙菲菲两位同学——他们在实习期间的突出表现，大家也是有目共睹。”
“他们在冯柳村驻村期间，坚持每天接诊，同时利用晚间时间对村民进行基础医学培训，编写了简易的草药识别手册。”
“在柳树沟爆发疫情后，他们第一时间赶赴现场参与救治，王大夫根据古方配制驱疫散，经过自身试药验证有效后投入临床使用，使疫情在一周内得到控制。”
话音落下，会场里安静了一瞬，然后响起掌声。
协会另一位负责人接过话，温和道：“所以，经协会研究决定——王大壮、孙菲菲两位学员，因在实训期间表现突出，经过我们一致讨论，决定让王大壮和孙菲菲两位学员，各获得二十万元个人奖金。同时，协会将拨出三十万元作为中医师承班的起始资金，由孙德厚大夫和王老师共同担任导师。”
台下又响起一阵掌声，比刚才更热烈了一些。
王大壮跟孙菲菲也是没想到能够拿到这笔巨款，心情都不由得愉快起来。
会议结束后，王大壮和孙菲菲被留了下来。
协会的工作人员把相关的文件和合同递到他们面前，王大壮签了自己的名字，把笔放下，又把孙菲菲签完字的文件摞在一起递给工作人员。
到时候，这笔钱就会直接转入他们账户里。
而紧跟着，张忠义拿起面前一份文件继续道：“另外，中医师承班的筹办工作将正式启动。王大壮和孙菲菲两位同志，将作为师承班的首批学员代表。师承班的日常教学和管理工作，由孙德厚和王建国两位同志担任导师，负责吸纳有志于中医的年轻人加入。”
这让中医协会的成员极为亢奋，能够开班中医师承班，而不是西医师承班，这本身就是一项莫大的荣誉。
张忠义紧跟着又拿起另一份文件，表情严肃道：“而关于这次实习期间出现的一些违规行为，我也要在这里向大家通报。张勇谋因涉嫌投毒，已被公安机关依法处理。其父亲张院长因涉嫌职务违规，已被相关部门调查。”
他的声音不高，但每一个字都清清楚楚，看向全场叮嘱道：“所以希望各位引以为戒，在医学领域，别试图走捷径，忘记自己救人的本分！”
第二百二十章开办师承班！获得二十万现金奖励！
长桌上安静了片刻，有人低头看了看桌面，有人把目光移向了窗外。
孙菲菲坐在王大壮旁边，目光落在桌面上那本摊开的笔记本上，什么也没说。

过了一会儿，张忠义把两份文件放下，目光重新落回王大壮和孙菲菲身上，语气比刚才轻了一些：“王大壮孙菲菲两位同志，这几天休息一下，调整好状态，师承班的事，下周正式开始。”
孙大夫走过来拍了拍王大壮的肩膀，鼓励道：“大壮，师承班的导师人选定了，我推荐你当助教。”
王大壮愣了一下：“我？我不太会教课。”
“不用你天天坐在教室里讲课。开一些讲座，带几回实践课，把你在村里给人看病、上山采药的经验教给学生就行。”
王大壮想了想，点了点头：“行，我带几堂实践课。”
散会之后，王大壮站在协会办公楼门口等孙菲菲从厕所里出来。
没过多久孙菲菲也走了出来，然后对王大壮说道：“大壮，师承班的事，你真的打算让我全权负责？”
“你比我合适，你科班出身，基础扎实，又在村里历练了这么久，知道怎么教人。”王大壮看着她，笑呵呵道：“我擅长的是给人看病，教人的事，你来。”
孙菲菲看着他：“那你以后打算怎么办？”
“回村里，继续给人看病。”王大壮的目光落在远处街道尽头那片灰蒙蒙的天际线上，“当然，师承班那边有什么事，你随时可以找我。”
孙菲菲也知道，王大壮的心并不在师承班，经过这段时间相处，他的能力孙菲菲最了解，知道他有更广阔的天空。
分别的时候，孙菲菲站在中西医协会的台阶上，看着王大壮转身走向街道尽头，他的背影越走越远。
“大壮，谢谢你，让我重新认识了这个世界的美好。”
王大壮坐上了回村的班车
。到镇上之后换了三轮车，颠簸了一个多小时，他终于看到了村口那棵老槐树的轮廓。
石板路还是那条石板路，屋檐下的玉米还挂着。
他推开自家院门，院子里安安静静的，小黑趴在枣树下的阴凉里，看到王大壮走进来愣了一下，然后从地上弹起来朝他扑过来，两只前爪搭在他膝盖上，尾巴摇得像风车。
“好了好了，我回来了。”王大壮拍了拍小黑的脑袋，在院子里喊了一声：“李姐——”
这时候，苗翠翠刚放学回来，看到王大壮愣了一下道：“大壮？你回来了？”
“刚回来，翠翠姐，这段时间怎么样？”王大壮打着招呼道。

content_en:
Chapter 220: Starting a tutoring class! Get a cash reward of two hundred thousand!
Zhang Zhongyi's eyes fell on Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei, and his tone was more formal than before: "Dear colleagues, the half-month clinical training of traditional Chinese and Western medicine has been successfully concluded. During this period, some young people with outstanding performance emerged, and some problems were also exposed."
He opened the folder in front of him: "In the five villages in Liushugou, the Chinese medicine students participating in the training have treated more than 300 people, distributed more than 170 doses of traditional Chinese medicine preparations, and completed acupuncture treatment for more than 80 people."
"The two students Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei are particularly worthy of praise - their outstanding performance during the internship is obvious to everyone."
"While they were stationed in Fengliu Village, they insisted on receiving medical treatment every day. At the same time, they used their evening time to provide basic medical training to the villagers and compiled a simple herbal identification manual."
"After the epidemic broke out in Liushugou, they rushed to the scene as soon as possible to participate in the treatment. Dr. Wang prepared the anti-epidemic powder based on ancient prescriptions. After being verified as effective by his own test medicine, it was put into clinical use, which brought the epidemic under control within a week."
After the words fell, the venue was quiet for a moment, and then applause broke out.
Another person in charge of the association took over and said gently: "So, after research and decision by the association, two trainees, Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei, have outstanding performance during the practical training. After our unanimous discussion, it was decided that Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei will each receive a personal bonus of 200,000 yuan. At the same time, the association will allocate 300,000 yuan as the starting fund for Chinese medicine practitioners to take over the class, with Dr. Sun Dehou and Teacher Wang serving as instructors."
There was another burst of applause from the audience, a little more enthusiastic than before.
Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei did not expect to get such a huge sum of money, and they couldn't help but feel happy.
After the meeting, Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei were left behind.
The staff of the association handed them the relevant documents and contracts. Wang Dazhuang signed his name, put down the pen, and stacked the documents signed by Sun Feifei together and handed them to the staff.
At that time, the money will be transferred directly to their account.
Immediately afterwards, Zhang Zhongyi picked up a document in front of him and continued: "In addition, the preparations for the traditional Chinese medicine practitioner class will be officially launched. Two comrades, Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei, will serve as the first batch of student representatives of the teacher-training class. In the daily teaching and management of the teacher-training class, two comrades, Sun Dehou and Wang Jianguo, will serve as mentors, responsible for attracting young people who are interested in traditional Chinese medicine to join."
This makes the members of the Traditional Chinese Medicine Association extremely excited. It is a great honor in itself to be able to start a class with a Chinese physician instead of a Western physician.
Zhang Zhongyi then picked up another document and said with a serious expression: "I would also like to inform everyone here about some violations that occurred during this internship. Zhang Yongmou has been handled by the public security organs in accordance with the law for suspected poisoning. His father, Dean Zhang, has been investigated by relevant departments for suspected violations of duties."
His voice was not high, but every word was clear. He looked at the audience and warned: "So I hope you can take this as a warning. In the medical field, don't try to take shortcuts and forget your duty to save people!"
Chapter 220: Starting a tutoring class! Get a cash reward of two hundred thousand!
The long table was quiet for a moment. Some people looked down at the table, while others looked out the window.
Sun Feifei sat next to Wang Dazhuang, her eyes fell on the open notebook on the table, and she said nothing.
After a while, Zhang Zhongyi put down the two documents and looked back at Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei. His tone was lighter than before: "Comrades Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei, please take a rest these days and adjust yourself. The teacher-to-teacher class will officially start next week."
Dr. Sun came over and patted Wang Dazhuang on the shoulder, encouraging him: "Dazhuang, the tutor of the tutoring class has been selected. I recommend you to be a teaching assistant."
kingDa Zhuang was stunned for a moment: "Me? I'm not very good at teaching."
"You don't need to sit in the classroom and give lectures every day. Just give some lectures, give a few practical classes, and teach students your experience of treating people in the village and collecting medicine in the mountains."
Wang Dazhuang thought for a while and nodded: "Okay, I will give a few practical lessons."
After the meeting, Wang Dazhuang stood at the door of the association office building and waited for Sun Feifei to come out of the toilet.
Not long after, Sun Feifei also came out, and then said to Wang Dazhuang: "Dazhuang, do you really plan to let me take full responsibility for the matter of the tutoring class?"
"You are more suitable than me. You came from a major and have a solid foundation. You have been practicing in the village for so long. You know how to teach people." Wang Dazhuang looked at her and said with a smile: "What I am good at is treating people and teaching them. You come here."
Sun Feifei looked at him: "Then what are you going to do in the future?"
"Go back to the village and continue to treat people." Wang Dazhuang's eyes fell on the gray skyline at the end of the street in the distance. "Of course, if anything happens at the apprenticeship class, you can always come to me."
Sun Feifei also knew that Wang Dazhuang's heart was not in the tutoring class. After getting along with him for this period of time, Sun Feifei understood his abilities best and knew that he had a broader sky.
When they were saying goodbye, Sun Feifei stood on the steps of the Association of Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine and watched Wang Dazhuang turn around and walk towards the end of the street, his back walking further and further away.
"Dazhuang, thank you for letting me know the beauty of this world again."
Wang Dazhuang got on the bus back to the village
. After arriving in the town, he changed to a tricycle and after more than an hour of bumpy driving, he finally saw the outline of the old locust tree at the entrance of the village.
The stone road is still the same stone road, and the corn is still hanging under the eaves.
He pushed open the door of his courtyard, and the courtyard was quiet. Xiao Hei was lying in the shade under the jujube tree. He was stunned for a moment when he saw Wang Dazhuang walking in. Then he jumped up from the ground and rushed towards him, with his two front paws on his knees and his tail wagging like a windmill.
"Okay, okay, I'm back." Wang Dazhuang patted Xiao Hei's head and shouted in the yard: "Sister Li——"
At this time, Miao Cuicui had just returned from school. When she saw Wang Dazhuang, she was stunned and said, "Dazhuang? Are you back?"
"Just came back, Sister Cuicui, how have you been doing these days?" Wang Dazhuang greeted.
